# Creek Caffe

> Home and outdoor coffee brewing guides: pour-over, French press, camp and backpacking coffee, cold brew, choosing beans and grind size, and espresso basics.

Creek Caffe is an editorial coffee education site with recipes given in grams and temperatures in Celsius and Fahrenheit. It does not sell coffee or equipment.

## Pages

- [Home](https://creekcaffe.com/): Overview with links to every brewing guide, a quick-start recipe table and coffee FAQ.
- [Pour-Over Coffee Guide: Ratio, Grind and Technique](https://creekcaffe.com/pour-over-coffee-guide.html): A reliable pour-over recipe, plus how to adjust grind, water and pouring to fix sour or bitter cups.
- [How to Use a French Press for Rich, Clean Coffee](https://creekcaffe.com/french-press-guide.html): The ratio, grind and steep time for full-bodied French press coffee without the sludge.
- [Camp Coffee: Best Ways to Brew Coffee Outdoors](https://creekcaffe.com/camp-coffee-methods.html): Cowboy coffee, AeroPress, pour-over and more for the trail, with altitude, water safety and Leave No Trace tips.
- [How to Make Cold Brew Coffee at Home](https://creekcaffe.com/cold-brew-coffee-guide.html): Concentrate and ready-to-drink ratios, steep times, filtering and storage for smooth cold brew.
- [Choosing Coffee Beans and the Right Grind Size](https://creekcaffe.com/coffee-beans-and-grind-size.html): Arabica vs robusta, origins, processing, roast levels, freshness, storage and a grind chart for every brewer.
- [Espresso Basics: How to Pull a Great Shot at Home](https://creekcaffe.com/espresso-basics.html): Dose, ratio, shot time, dialing in, milk steaming and the gear that actually matters.
